title: Finite cohomology image filtration of a degreewise finite filtered complex
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K an integer-indexed cochain complex, and L a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Define I_n^p=im(H^n(L^p K)→H^n(K)); functoriality of homology makes I_n a decreasing filtration. Suppose that for every integer j there exist integers lo,hi with L^lo K^j=K^j and L^hi K^j=0, where degree steps are defined in [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Then for every integer n the cohomology image filtration I_n is finite.

source.place: Tag 012P, definition of induced cohomology filtration; Tag 012W, part (2)

proof.text: Construct I_n by the images of the maps on homology. For p≤q the inclusion L^q→K factors through L^p→K. Functoriality of homology and imageSubobject_comp_le prove antitonicity. The same argument in degree j proves antitonicity of the degree steps.

Take the minimum lo of the lower bounds in the predecessor, middle and successor degrees of n. All three degree steps are top by antitonicity. Evaluation of the subcomplex inclusion is monic; top image makes it an isomorphism in these three degrees. The induced short-complex map is an isomorphism, so quasiIsoAt_iff implies an isomorphism on H^n and I_n^lo=top.

At the upper bound hi in degree n the subcomplex inclusion is zero and monic. Its source term is therefore zero. ExactAt.of_isZero and ExactAt.isZero_homology give zero H^n of this subcomplex, so its homology map has zero image. Thus I_n^hi=bottom, giving the two finite-filtration bounds.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomologyImage_isFinite
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ lo hi : ℤ,
      L.complexStep lo n = ⊤ ∧ L.complexStep hi n = ⊥)
    (n : ℤ) : (L.cohomologyImage n).IsFinite
